title.narrative: Policy-relevant analysis and recommendations that advance inclusive approaches to peace and security in fragile, conflict-affected, and developing contexts

Development of evidence-based guidance to inform efforts to address WPS challenges in fragile, conflict-affected, and developing contexts. 1.Long-form report with findings from global survey of women peacebuilders, outlining key trends, challenges, and opportunities in the WPS field. 2.Policy brief with concrete recommendations to improve WPS policy. 3. Two profiles of developing countries experiencing conflict that are updated regularly based on a WPS analysis.

target.value: Analysis of conflicted-affected contexts is missing a gender lens and women peacebuilders perspectives are under-represented in decision-making.
GIWPS has developed and shared concrete, actionable guidance based on original analysis that can be used to promote better WPS outcomes in fragile, conflict-affected and developing contexts.

title.narrative: Policy-relevant analysis and recommendations that advance inclusive approaches to peace and security in fragile, conflict-affected, and developing contexts

This project will provide forward-looking recommendations to shape the global WPS Agenda for the next decade based on the insights from women peacebuilders around the world. Report detailing the findings of a global survey of women peacebuilders, including analysis of key trends and patterns. Policy brief with concrete recommendations to improve WPS policy.

target.value: GIWPS develops concrete guidance and recommendations for how WPS actors can improve policy and practice in the next 25 years.

actual.value: conducted an in-depth analysis of 1,000 responses from Ukraine and used the findings to inform a timely, high-level roundtable conversation in May 2026 hosted by the Embassy of Denmark to the US, with CEIP. 2 reports published. Briefings at Senate for staffers. Event Japan mission UNNY.

target.value: GIWPS develops and fields a global survey of women peacebuilders focused on identifying key WPS issues from their perspectives

actual.value: created a robust and inclusive survey tool. The survey was launched on May 5th, 2025. As of May 27th, the survey has collected nearly 2,500 responses. Made survey report with g key findings and concrete policy recommendations. UNDK high-level launch event during a week of gatherings to commemorate the 25th anniversary of UNSCR 1325.

title.narrative: Policy-relevant analysis and recommendations that advance inclusive approaches to peace and security in fragile, conflict-affected, and developing contexts

Phase II of this project will generate in-depth analysis of 10 WPS Tracker countries to inform country profiles on GIWPS tracker website. These profiles will include unique and timely policy recommendations for each country. Two country profiles with tailored policy recommendations added to GIWPS tracker website.

target.value: Country profiles are continually updated based on monthly WPS analysis.

actual.value: Country profiles are continually updated based on monthly WPS analysis. Added two additional countries. hosted three Meet the Moment events, each centered around a tracker country. Report published, and 5 tracker-related outputs published

target.value: 2 country profiles are developed and featured on GIWPS tracker website.

actual.value: development of in-depth country profiles of 25 WPS Tracker countries
